## Overview

This extension builds on `XR_EXT_spatial_entity` and defines a spatial capability for tracking a set of predefined objects without requiring an input dataset from the application.

## Runtime Support

If the runtime supports object tracking, it **must** indicate this by enumerating `XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT` in [xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilitiesEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilitiesEXT) .

## Configuration

The [XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT) structure is defined as:

    typedef struct XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT {
        XrStructureType                     type;
        const void*                         next;
        XrSpatialCapabilityEXT              capability;
        uint32_t                            enabledComponentCount;
        const XrSpatialComponentTypeEXT*    enabledComponents;
    } XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT;

### Member Descriptions

- `type` is the [XrStructureType](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrStructureType) of this structure.
- `next` is `NULL` or a pointer to the next structure in a structure chain.
- `capability` is an [XrSpatialCapabilityEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityEXT) and **must** be `XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT` .
- `enabledComponentCount` is a `uint32_t` describing the count of elements in the `enabledComponents` array.
- `enabledComponents` is a pointer to an array of [XrSpatialComponentTypeEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentTypeEXT) .

Applications **can** enable the `XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT` spatial capability by adding a pointer to the [XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT) structure in [XrSpatialContextCreateInfoEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialContextCreateInfoEXT) :: `capabilityConfigs` .

The runtime **must** return `XR_ERROR_VALIDATION_FAILURE` if `capability` is not `XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT` .

### Valid Usage (Implicit)

- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT-extension-notenabled) The `XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking` extension **must** be enabled prior to using [XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT)
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT-type-type) `type` **must** be `XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_CONFIGURATION_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT`
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT-next-next) `next` **must** be `NULL` or a valid pointer to the [next structure in a structure chain](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#valid-usage-for-structure-pointer-chains) . See also: [XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT)
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT-capability-parameter) `capability` **must** be a valid [XrSpatialCapabilityEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityEXT) value
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT-enabledComponents-parameter) `enabledComponents` **must** be a pointer to an array of `enabledComponentCount` valid [XrSpatialComponentTypeEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentTypeEXT) values
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT-enabledComponentCount-arraylength) The `enabledComponentCount` parameter **must** be greater than `0`

## Guaranteed Components

A runtime that supports `XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT` , **must** support the following spatial components as guaranteed components of the entities discovered by this capability and **must** enumerate them in [xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT) :

- `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_BOUNDED_3D_EXT`
- At least one component type that provides a set of semantic label for the tracked objects. An object tracking capability is meaningless without a semantic label component. While this extension defines `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` and `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` as possible semantic label components for runtimes to support, other extensions **may** define new component types to provide different classes of semantic labels that describe a tracked object. See [\[ext_spatial_semantic_labels_guidelines\]](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#ext_spatial_semantic_labels_guidelines) for details about the semantic label sets and component types design. Runtimes **may** not support either of `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` or `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` for the object tracking capability but **must** support at least one component type that provides a semantic label.

### Bounded 3D Component

The bounded 3D component provides the center and extents of the object represented by the entity it is on. See [Bounded 3D](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#ext_spatial_entity_bounded3D_component) for more details.

## Optional Components

A runtime that supports `XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT` , **may** support spatial components in addition to the ones listed in the [Guaranteed Components](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#ext_spatial_object_tracking_guaranteed_components) section. The application **can** use [xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT) to get the full list of components that a runtime supports and **can** then configure the ones it is interested in when creating the spatial context.

### Object Semantic Label

###### Component data

    typedef enum XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT {
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_UNCATEGORIZED_EXT = 1,
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_SOFA_EXT = 2,
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_BED_EXT = 3,
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_CHAIR_EXT = 4,
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_TABLE_EXT = 5,
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_LAMP_EXT = 6,
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_PLANT_EXT = 7,
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_DISPLAY_SCREEN_EXT = 8,
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_WALL_ART_EXT = 9,
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_CABINET_EXT = 10,
        XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_MAX_ENUM_EXT = 0x7FFFFFFF
    } XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT;

The [XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT) enumeration describes a set of semantic labels for objects.

For entities with the `XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_DISPLAY_SCREEN_EXT` label, the +Z axis of the [Bounded 3D](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#ext_spatial_entity_bounded3D_component) component **must** roughly match the surface normal of the screen.

For entities with the `XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_WALL_ART_EXT` label, the +Z axis of the [Bounded 3D](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#ext_spatial_entity_bounded3D_component) component **must** match the surface normal of the wall the art is discovered on.

For entities with the `XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_TABLE_EXT` label, the +Z axis of the [Bounded 3D](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#ext_spatial_entity_bounded3D_component) component **must** match the surface normal of the table.

For all the other labels in [XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT) , the application **must** not make any assumptions about how the [XrBoxf](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrBoxf) :: `center` :: `orientation` provided by the [Bounded 3D](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#ext_spatial_entity_bounded3D_component) component on the entity aligns with the physical attributes of that object.

The enumeration values have the following meanings:

Enum Description

`XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_UNCATEGORIZED_EXT`

The runtime was unable to classify this entity.

`XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_SOFA_EXT`

The entity is a sofa.

`XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_BED_EXT`

The entity is a bed.

`XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_CHAIR_EXT`

The entity is a chair.

`XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_TABLE_EXT`

The entity is a table.

`XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_LAMP_EXT`

The entity is a lamp.

`XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_PLANT_EXT`

The entity is a plant.

`XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_DISPLAY_SCREEN_EXT`

The entity is a display screen, like a monitor or TV.

`XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_WALL_ART_EXT`

The entity is a wall art.

`XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_CABINET_EXT`

The entity is a cabinet.

###### Component List Structure to Query Data

The [XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT) structure is defined as:

    typedef struct XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT {
        XrStructureType                     type;
        void*                               next;
        uint32_t                            semanticLabelCount;
        XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT*    semanticLabels;
    } XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT;

### Member Descriptions

- `type` is the [XrStructureType](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrStructureType) of this structure.
- `next` is `NULL` or a pointer to the next structure in a structure chain. No such structures are defined in core OpenXR or this extension.
- `semanticLabelCount` is a `uint32_t` describing the count of elements in the `semanticLabels` array.
- `semanticLabels` is an array of [XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT) .

To query the object semantic label component of the spatial entities in an [XrSpatialSnapshotEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialSnapshotEXT) , include `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` in [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT) :: `componentTypes` and add [XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT) to the [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT) :: `next` chain.

The runtime **must** return `XR_ERROR_VALIDATION_FAILURE` from [xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT) if [XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT) is in the [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT) :: `next` chain but `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` is not included in [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT) :: `componentTypes` .

The runtime **must** return `XR_ERROR_SIZE_INSUFFICIENT` from [xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT) if `semanticLabelCount` is less than [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT) :: `entityIdCountOutput` .

### Valid Usage (Implicit)

- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT-extension-notenabled) The `XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking` extension **must** be enabled prior to using [XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT)
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT-type-type) `type` **must** be `XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_LIST_EXT`
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT-next-next) `next` **must** be `NULL` or a valid pointer to the [next structure in a structure chain](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#valid-usage-for-structure-pointer-chains)
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT-semanticLabels-parameter) `semanticLabels` **must** be a pointer to an array of `semanticLabelCount` [XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT) values
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentObjectSemanticLabelListEXT-semanticLabelCount-arraylength) The `semanticLabelCount` parameter **must** be greater than `0`

###### Configuration

If `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` is enumerated in [XrSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT) :: `componentTypes` for some capability, an application **can** enable it by including the enumerant in the [XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT) :: `enabledComponents` list of the [XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT) derived structure of the capability that supports this component.

This component does not require any special configuration to be included in the [XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT) :: `next` chain but does offer an optional configuration for applications to provide.

The [XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT) structure is defined as:

    typedef struct XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT {
        XrStructureType                           type;
        const void*                               next;
        uint32_t                                  semanticLabelCount;
        const XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT*    semanticLabels;
    } XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT;

### Member Descriptions

- `type` is the [XrStructureType](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrStructureType) of this structure.
- `next` is `NULL` or a pointer to the next structure in a structure chain.
- `semanticLabelCount` is a `uint32_t` describing the count of elements in the `semanticLabels` array.
- `semanticLabels` is an array of [XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT) .

If the runtime enumerates `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` from [xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT) for a given capability, it **must** also enumerate `XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_FEATURE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_SUBSET_EXT` from [xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityFeaturesEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityFeaturesEXT) for the same capability. If an application enables `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` when configuring that capability, it **can** chain [XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT) to the corresponding configuration structure of that capability to provide the runtime with a subset of labels defined in [XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT) . The runtime **may** use this subset of labels to optimize its tracking pipelines.

The runtime **must** return `XR_ERROR_VALIDATION_FAILURE` from [xrCreateSpatialContextAsyncEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrCreateSpatialContextAsyncEXT) if `semanticLabels` contains any label that is not defined in [XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT) or if `semanticLabels` contains `XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_UNCATEGORIZED_EXT` .

The runtime **must** return `XR_ERROR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_NOT_ENABLED_EXT` from [xrCreateSpatialContextAsyncEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrCreateSpatialContextAsyncEXT) if the application provides a valid list of labels in `semanticLabels` but `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` is not included in the [XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT) :: `enabledComponents` array of the configuration structure that [XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT) is chained to.

If the application configures a capability with a valid [XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT) , the runtime **must** not include entities that have semantic labels which are not listed in `semanticLabels` in any discovery snapshot created for the configured spatial context.

### Valid Usage (Implicit)

- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT-extension-notenabled) The `XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking` extension **must** be enabled prior to using [XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT)
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT-type-type) `type` **must** be `XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_FEATURE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_SUBSET_EXT`
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT-next-next) `next` **must** be `NULL` or a valid pointer to the [next structure in a structure chain](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#valid-usage-for-structure-pointer-chains)
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT-semanticLabels-parameter) `semanticLabels` **must** be a pointer to an array of `semanticLabelCount` valid [XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT) values
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT-semanticLabelCount-arraylength) The `semanticLabelCount` parameter **must** be greater than `0`

### Keyboard Semantic Label

###### Component data

    typedef enum XrSpatialKeyboardSemanticLabelEXT {
        XR_SPATIAL_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_UNCATEGORIZED_EXT = 1,
        XR_SPATIAL_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_KEYBOARD_EXT = 2,
        XR_SPATIAL_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_MAX_ENUM_EXT = 0x7FFFFFFF
    } XrSpatialKeyboardSemanticLabelEXT;

The [XrSpatialKeyboardSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialKeyboardSemanticLabelEXT) enumeration describes a semantic label for a keyboard.

The extents and orientation of `XR_SPATIAL_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_KEYBOARD_EXT` represented by the [Bounded 3D](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#ext_spatial_entity_bounded3D_component) component on the same entity is shown in the [following image](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#fig-spatial_object_tracking-keyboard-orientation) (with xyz = rgb) originating at the center of the object.

###### Component List Struct to Query Data

The [XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT) structure is defined as:

    typedef struct XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT {
        XrStructureType                       type;

### Member Descriptions

- `type` is the [XrStructureType](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrStructureType) of this structure.
- `next` is `NULL` or a pointer to the next structure in a structure chain. No such structures are defined in core OpenXR or this extension.
- `semanticLabelCount` is a `uint32_t` describing the count of elements in the `semanticLabels` array.
- `semanticLabels` is an array of [XrSpatialKeyboardSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialKeyboardSemanticLabelEXT) .

To query the keyboard semantic label component of the spatial entities in an [XrSpatialSnapshotEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialSnapshotEXT) , include `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` in [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT) :: `componentTypes` and add [XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT) to the [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT) :: `next` chain.

The runtime **must** return `XR_ERROR_VALIDATION_FAILURE` from [xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT) if [XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT) is in the [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT) :: `next` chain but `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` is not included in [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT) :: `componentTypes` .

The runtime **must** return `XR_ERROR_SIZE_INSUFFICIENT` from [xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT) if `semanticLabelCount` is less than [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT) :: `entityIdCountOutput` .

### Valid Usage (Implicit)

- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT-extension-notenabled) The `XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking` extension **must** be enabled prior to using [XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT)
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT-type-type) `type` **must** be `XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_LIST_EXT`
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT-next-next) `next` **must** be `NULL` or a valid pointer to the [next structure in a structure chain](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#valid-usage-for-structure-pointer-chains)
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT-semanticLabels-parameter) `semanticLabels` **must** be a pointer to an array of `semanticLabelCount` [XrSpatialKeyboardSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialKeyboardSemanticLabelEXT) values
- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT-semanticLabelCount-arraylength) The `semanticLabelCount` parameter **must** be greater than `0`

###### Configuration

If `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` is enumerated in [XrSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT) :: `componentTypes` for some capability, an application **can** enable it by including the enumerant in the [XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT) :: `enabledComponents` list of the [XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT) derived structure of the capability that supports this component.

This component does not require any special configuration to be included in the [XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT) :: `next` chain.

### Mouse Semantic Label

###### Component data

    typedef enum XrSpatialMouseSemanticLabelEXT {
        XR_SPATIAL_MOUSE_SEMANTIC_LABEL_UNCATEGORIZED_EXT = 1,
        XR_SPATIAL_MOUSE_SEMANTIC_LABEL_MOUSE_EXT = 2,
        XR_SPATIAL_MOUSE_SEMANTIC_LABEL_MAX_ENUM_EXT = 0x7FFFFFFF
    } XrSpatialMouseSemanticLabelEXT;

The [XrSpatialMouseSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialMouseSemanticLabelEXT) enumeration describes a semantic label for a mouse.

Enum Description

`XR_SPATIAL_MOUSE_SEMANTIC_LABEL_UNCATEGORIZED_EXT`

The runtime was unable to classify this entity.

`XR_SPATIAL_MOUSE_SEMANTIC_LABEL_MOUSE_EXT`

The entity is a mouse.

###### Component List Struct to Query Data

The [XrSpatialComponentMouseSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentMouseSemanticLabelListEXT) structure is defined as:

    typedef struct XrSpatialComponentMouseSemanticLabelListEXT {
        XrStructureType                    type;
        void*                              next;
        uint32_t                           semanticLabelCount;
        XrSpatialMouseSemanticLabelEXT*    semanticLabels;
    } XrSpatialComponentMouseSemanticLabelListEXT;

### Member Descriptions

- `type` is the [XrStructureType](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrStructureType) of this structure.
- `next` is `NULL` or a pointer to the next structure in a structure chain. No such structures are defined in core OpenXR or this extension.
- `semanticLabelCount` is a `uint32_t` describing the count of elements in the `semanticLabels` array.
- `semanticLabels` is an array of [XrSpatialMouseSemanticLabelEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialMouseSemanticLabelEXT) .

To query the mouse semantic label component of the spatial entities in an [XrSpatialSnapshotEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialSnapshotEXT) , include `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_MOUSE_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` in [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT) :: `componentTypes` and add [XrSpatialComponentMouseSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentMouseSemanticLabelListEXT) to the [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT) :: `next` chain.

The runtime **must** return `XR_ERROR_VALIDATION_FAILURE` from [xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT) if [XrSpatialComponentMouseSemanticLabelListEXT](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#XrSpatialComponentMouseSemanticLabelListEXT) is in the [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT) :: `next` chain but `XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_MOUSE_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT` is not included in [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT) :: `componentTypes` .

The runtime **must** return `XR_ERROR_SIZE_INSUFFICIENT` from [xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT) if `semanticLabelCount` is less than [XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT) :: `entityIdCountOutput` .

### Valid Usage (Implicit)

- [](https://developer.android.com/develop/xr/openxr/extensions/XR_EXT_spatial_object_tracking#VUID-XrSpatialComponentMouseSemanticLabelListEXT-next-next) `next` **must** be `NULL` or a valid pointer to the [next structure in a structure chain](https://registry.khronos.org/OpenXR/specs/1.1/html/xrspec.html#valid-usage-for-structure-pointer-chains)

## Example code

### Configure Object Tracking Capability

The following example code demonstrates how to configure object tracking capability when creating a spatial context.

    // Check if object tracking capability is supported
    uint32_t capabilityCount;
    CHK_XR(xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilitiesEXT(instance, systemId, 0, &capabilityCount, nullptr));
    std::vector<XrSpatialCapabilityEXT> capabilities(capabilityCount);
    CHK_XR(xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilitiesEXT(instance, systemId, capabilityCount, &capabilityCount, capabilities.data()));

    if (std::find(capabilities.begin(), capabilities.end(), XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT) == capabilities.end()) {
      return;
    }

    // Enumerate supported components for object tracking capability
    XrSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT objectComponents{XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_COMPONENT_TYPES_EXT};
    CHK_XR(xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT(instance, systemId, XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT, &objectComponents));
    std::vector<XrSpatialComponentTypeEXT> objectCapabilityComponents(objectComponents.componentTypeCountOutput);
    objectComponents.componentTypeCapacityInput = objectCapabilityComponents.size();
    objectComponents.componentTypes = objectCapabilityComponents.data();
    CHK_XR(xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityComponentTypesEXT(instance, systemId, XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT, &objectComponents));

    // Check if the object & keyboard semantic labels component is supported
    const auto supportsComponent = [&objectCapabilityComponents](XrSpatialComponentTypeEXT component) {
      return std::find(objectCapabilityComponents.begin(), objectCapabilityComponents.end(), component) != objectCapabilityComponents.end();
    };

    const bool supportsObjectSemanticLabel = supportsComponent(XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT);
    const bool supportsKeyboardSemanticLabel = supportsComponent(XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT);

    // Enumerate supported features for object tracking capability
    uint32_t featureCount;
    CHK_XR(xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityFeaturesEXT(instance, systemId, XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT, 0, &featureCount, nullptr));
    std::vector<XrSpatialCapabilityFeatureEXT> features(featureCount);
    CHK_XR(xrEnumerateSpatialCapabilityFeaturesEXT(instance, systemId, XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT, featureCount, &featureCount, features.data()));

    const bool supportsObjectSemanticLabelSubsetFeature = std::find(features.begin(), features.end(), XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_FEATURE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_SUBSET_EXT) != features.end();

    // Create a spatial context
    XrSpatialContextEXT spatialContext{};

    // Enable the guaranteed components of the object tracking capability
    std::vector<XrSpatialComponentTypeEXT> enabledComponents = {
      XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_BOUNDED_3D_EXT,
    };
    // Optionally enable the supported semantic labels
    if (supportsObjectSemanticLabel) {
      enabledComponents.push_back(XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT);
    }
    if (supportsKeyboardSemanticLabel) {
      enabledComponents.push_back(XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT);
    }

    // We only want to track sofa and table.
    std::vector<XrSpatialObjectSemanticLabelEXT> objectSemanticLabelSubset = {
      XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_SOFA_EXT,
      XR_SPATIAL_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_TABLE_EXT
    };
    XrSpatialFeatureObjectSemanticLabelSubsetEXT subsetFeature{XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_FEATURE_OBJECT_SEMANTIC_LABEL_SUBSET_EXT};
    subsetFeature.semanticLabelCount = objectSemanticLabelSubset.size();
    subsetFeature.semanticLabels = objectSemanticLabelSubset.data();

    XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationObjectTrackingEXT objectTrackingConfig{XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_CONFIGURATION_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT};
    objectTrackingConfig.capability = XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT;
    objectTrackingConfig.enabledComponentCount = enabledComponents.size();
    objectTrackingConfig.enabledComponents = enabledComponents.data();
    if (supportsObjectSemanticLabelSubsetFeature) {
      objectTrackingConfig.next = &subsetFeature;
    }

    std::array<XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT*, 1> capabilityConfigs = {
      reinterpret_cast<XrSpatialCapabilityConfigurationBaseHeaderEXT*>(&objectTrackingConfig),
    };

    XrSpatialContextCreateInfoEXT spatialContextCreateInfo{XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_CONTEXT_CREATE_INFO_EXT};
    spatialContextCreateInfo.capabilityConfigCount = capabilityConfigs.size();
    spatialContextCreateInfo.capabilityConfigs = capabilityConfigs.data();
    XrFutureEXT createContextFuture;
    CHK_XR(xrCreateSpatialContextAsyncEXT(session, &spatialContextCreateInfo, &createContextFuture));

    waitUntilReady(createContextFuture);

    XrCreateSpatialContextCompletionEXT completion{XR_TYPE_CREATE_SPATIAL_CONTEXT_COMPLETION_EXT};
    CHK_XR(xrCreateSpatialContextCompleteEXT(session, createContextFuture, &completion));
    if (completion.futureResult != XR_SUCCESS) {
      return;
    }

    spatialContext = completion.spatialContext;

    // ...
    // Discovery entities with the spatial context
    // ...

    CHK_XR(xrDestroySpatialContextEXT(spatialContext));

### Discover Spatial Entities \& Query Component Data

The following example code demonstrates how to discover spatial entities for a context configured with `XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_OBJECT_TRACKING_EXT` and query its component data.

    XrFutureEXT future = XR_NULL_FUTURE_EXT;

    // We want to look for entities that have the following components.
    std::vector<XrSpatialComponentTypeEXT> snapshotComponents = {
      XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_BOUNDED_3D_EXT,
    };
    if (supportsKeyboardSemanticLabel) {
      snapshotComponents.push_back(XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_EXT);
    }

    auto discoverSpatialEntities = [&](XrSpatialContextEXT spatialContext, XrTime time) {
      XrSpatialDiscoverySnapshotCreateInfoEXT snapshotCreateInfo{XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_DISCOVERY_SNAPSHOT_CREATE_INFO_EXT};
      snapshotCreateInfo.componentTypeCount = snapshotComponents.size();
      snapshotCreateInfo.componentTypes = snapshotComponents.data();
      CHK_XR(xrCreateSpatialDiscoverySnapshotAsyncEXT(spatialContext, &snapshotCreateInfo, &future));

      waitUntilReady(future);

      XrCreateSpatialDiscoverySnapshotCompletionInfoEXT completionInfo{XR_TYPE_CREATE_SPATIAL_DISCOVERY_SNAPSHOT_COMPLETION_INFO_EXT};
      completionInfo.baseSpace = localSpace;
      completionInfo.time = time;
      completionInfo.future = future;

      XrCreateSpatialDiscoverySnapshotCompletionEXT completion{XR_TYPE_CREATE_SPATIAL_DISCOVERY_SNAPSHOT_COMPLETION_EXT};
      CHK_XR(xrCreateSpatialDiscoverySnapshotCompleteEXT(spatialContext, &completionInfo, &completion));
      if (completion.futureResult == XR_SUCCESS) {

        // Query for the semantic label component data
        XrSpatialComponentDataQueryConditionEXT queryCond{XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_DATA_QUERY_CONDITION_EXT};
        queryCond.componentTypeCount = snapshotComponents.size();
        queryCond.componentTypes = snapshotComponents.data();

        XrSpatialComponentDataQueryResultEXT queryResult{XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_DATA_QUERY_RESULT_EXT};
        CHK_XR(xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT(completion.snapshot, &queryCond, &queryResult));

        std::vector<XrSpatialEntityIdEXT> entityIds(queryResult.entityIdCountOutput);
        std::vector<XrSpatialEntityTrackingStateEXT> entityStates(queryResult.entityIdCountOutput);
        queryResult.entityIdCapacityInput = entityIds.size();
        queryResult.entityIds = entityIds.data();
        queryResult.entityStateCapacityInput = entityStates.size();
        queryResult.entityStates = entityStates.data();

        std::vector<XrBoxf> bounded3D(queryResult.entityIdCountOutput);
        XrSpatialComponentBounded3DListEXT bounded3DList{XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_BOUNDED_3D_LIST_EXT};
        bounded3DList.boundCount = bounded3D.size();
        bounded3DList.bounds = bounded3D.data();
        queryResult.next = &bounded3DList;

        std::vector<XrSpatialKeyboardSemanticLabelEXT> semanticLabels;
        XrSpatialComponentKeyboardSemanticLabelListEXT semanticLabelsList{XR_TYPE_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_KEYBOARD_SEMANTIC_LABEL_LIST_EXT};
        if (supportsKeyboardSemanticLabel) {
          semanticLabels.resize(queryResult.entityIdCountOutput);
          semanticLabelsList.semanticLabelCount = semanticLabels.size();
          semanticLabelsList.semanticLabels = semanticLabels.data();
          semanticLabelsList.next = queryResult.next;
          queryResult.next = &semanticLabelsList;
        }

        CHK_XR(xrQuerySpatialComponentDataEXT(completion.snapshot, &queryCond, &queryResult));

        for (int32_t i = 0; i < queryResult.entityIdCountOutput; ++i) {
          if (entityStates[i] != XR_SPATIAL_ENTITY_TRACKING_STATE_TRACKING_EXT) {
            continue;
          }

          // 3D bounds for entity entityIds[i] is bounded3D[i].extents centered on bounded3D[i].center.

          if (supportsKeyboardSemanticLabel) {
            // semantic label for entity entityIds[i] is semanticLabels[i].
          }
        }

        CHK_XR(xrDestroySpatialSnapshotEXT(completion.snapshot));
      }
    };

    while (1) {
      // ...
      // For every frame in frame loop
      // ...

      XrFrameState frameState;  // previously returned from xrWaitFrame
      const XrTime time = frameState.predictedDisplayTime;

      // Poll for the XR_TYPE_EVENT_DATA_SPATIAL_DISCOVERY_RECOMMENDED_EXT event
      XrEventDataBuffer event = {XR_TYPE_EVENT_DATA_BUFFER};
      XrResult result = xrPollEvent(instance, &event);
      if (result == XR_SUCCESS) {
          switch (event.type) {
              case XR_TYPE_EVENT_DATA_SPATIAL_DISCOVERY_RECOMMENDED_EXT: {
                  const XrEventDataSpatialDiscoveryRecommendedEXT& eventdata =
                      *reinterpret_cast<XrEventDataSpatialDiscoveryRecommendedEXT*>(&event);
                  // Discover spatial entities for the context that we received the "discovery
                  // recommended" event for.
                  discoverSpatialEntities(eventdata.spatialContext, time);
                  break;
              }
          }
      }

      // ...
      // Finish frame loop
      // ...
    }
